title: RSNA Screening Mammography Breast Cancer Detection
description: Identify breast cancer in screening mammograms. Massive class imbalance (approx 2% positive cases), multi-view DICOM format (CC and MLO views per breast), patient-level evaluation. Severe penalty for false positives and false negatives.
data_summary: Full-field digital mammography (FFDM) in 16-bit DICOM. 54,000 screening images from over 11,000 patients across 4 acquisition systems.
